name: focused-v1
purpose: 围绕复杂架构图、密集前端页面、精细成年人物进行20项合成内容压力样例；每项一次，不自动重抽。

cases.label: RAG 服务 / 12节点16有向边
cases.prompt: A precise technical architecture diagram on a white canvas, flat vector style, generous spacing, dark charcoal text, restrained teal and blue. Exactly 12 labeled nodes: Client, API, Auth, Router, Embed, Vector DB, Rerank, Prompt, LLM, Cache, Logs, Storage. Draw exactly these directed connections: Client to API; API to Auth; Auth to Router; Router to Cache; Cache to API; Router to Embed; Embed to Vector DB; Vector DB to Rerank; Rerank to Prompt; Prompt to LLM; LLM to API; LLM to Cache; API to Logs; Router to Logs; Storage to Embed; LLM to Logs. Put the main request path across the middle, cache above it, observability and storage below. Use orthogonal connectors with clear arrowheads. Group the retrieval steps inside a pale blue Retrieval container and the model steps inside a pale teal Generation container. No decorative computers or 3D art.
checks: 12个节点是否全部存在且标签准确
不可只因视觉整齐就当正确架构图

cases.label: 多Agent编排 / 并行与审批
cases.prompt: A sophisticated readable multi-agent workflow diagram for a technical presentation, flat vector illustration on white. Ten distinct nodes labeled User, Gateway, Planner, Researcher, Coder, Reviewer, Tools, Memory, Approval, Result. Main flow User to Gateway to Planner. Planner splits into Researcher and Coder. Both feed Reviewer. Reviewer goes to Approval, then Result. Reviewer has a dashed retry loop back to Planner. Researcher and Coder connect to a shared Tools row below; Planner connects to Memory above. Use separate pale colored containers for orchestration, workers and shared services, coherent left-to-right hierarchy, thin orthogonal arrows, legible short labels, professional documentation aesthetics, no brand logos.
checks: 文字与箭头不能只看大概

cases.label: 微服务 / 网关与事件总线
cases.prompt: A detailed cloud-native commerce system architecture diagram, modern flat technical vector drawing on white. Across the top place Web and Mobile clients feeding an API Gateway. Below it show three clearly separated service boxes: Catalog, Orders, Payments. Each service has its own small database cylinder directly underneath. Below the services draw a horizontal Event Bus connected to Orders and Payments. At the bottom right show a Notifications worker consuming events. At the far right place a Monitoring column linked by dotted telemetry lines. Show a Redis Cache beside Catalog. Group application services in a large light-blue Application boundary and databases in a light-gray Data boundary. Accurate readable English labels, consistent arrow direction, no pictorial decorations, no logos.
checks: Web/Mobile、三业务服务、独立数据库
事件总线和通知消费者关系

cases.label: 机器学习 / 训练与在线推理
cases.prompt: A clean detailed machine learning platform architecture diagram with two horizontal lanes on a white background. Upper lane titled TRAINING: Raw Data to Validation to Features to Train to Evaluate to Registry. Lower lane titled SERVING: Request to Preprocess to Model to Response. Registry connects downward to Model with a deployment arrow. A Metrics node below Model sends a dashed feedback arrow back to Evaluate. Add a small Version Store connected to Features and Registry. Use rounded rectangular nodes, teal for training, blue for serving, amber for monitoring, clear readable short English labels and orthogonal directional connectors. Plenty of white space despite the detailed topology, technical documentation rather than decorative illustration.

cases.label: 论文方法图 / 双分支与融合
cases.prompt: A publication-style neural network method diagram, white background, crisp flat vector shapes, elegant restrained pastel colors. On the left show an Image input feeding Patch Embed then three stacked Vision Blocks. Beneath it show a Text input feeding Token Embed then three stacked Text Blocks. Both branches enter one central Cross Attention block, then a Fusion block, then two heads on the right labeled Classifier and Retrieval. Show small token-grid illustrations inside the two branches and thin directed arrows connecting every stage. Use clearly separated Image Encoder and Text Encoder containers. Exact readable English labels. This is a scientific method figure, not a rendered computer setup.
checks: 论文图所需结构准确性

cases.label: 架构展示稿 / 深色分层
cases.prompt: A polished dark-background system architecture presentation slide for a document intelligence platform. Three horizontal layers, with concise labels: INPUT at the top with PDF, Image, Audio cards; PROCESS in the middle with OCR, Parse, Embed, Retrieve cards; OUTPUT at the bottom with Search, Report, API cards. Thin glowing teal directional connectors between layers, aligned grids, clear readable white typography, restrained navy background and subtle blue grouping panels. Use small consistent line icons inside each card. No huge title, no decorative particles, no photorealistic machines. Dense enough to communicate a real platform but with clean visual hierarchy.
checks: 短标签准确与层级清楚
展示图不等于完整技术规格

cases.label: RAG工作台 / 三栏证据面板
cases.prompt: A highly polished desktop web application screenshot for a research assistant workspace. Three functional columns: a narrow left sidebar with document folders and selected PDF files; a generous central conversation area with a user question, a well-structured answer and inline numbered citation markers; a right evidence panel showing two source excerpts with highlighted sentences and page numbers. Add a compact top workspace bar, document upload button, retrieval status and a bottom question composer. Warm off-white background, deep navy text, restrained teal accents, excellent typography and spacing, realistic information density, precise alignment, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no glass effects. Short labels: Library, Chat, Sources, Upload, Ask.
checks: 三栏职责、引用编号、证据页码
文字是否真正可读、非可交互前端

cases.label: 可观测性 / 指标日志追踪
cases.prompt: A sophisticated dark desktop observability dashboard screenshot for an API service. Left navigation sidebar, top time-range selector and environment dropdown. Four small KPI summaries across the top: Requests, Latency, Errors, Uptime. A large multi-series latency time chart occupies the center left and a compact service-health list sits to its right. Below, a dense but readable log table with timestamp, severity, service and message columns. An expanded trace row shows a short horizontal waterfall. Restrained charcoal navy background, soft gray text, muted cyan and amber signals, sharp professional typography, consistent spacing, no neon decoration, no device frame.
checks: 四指标、时间过滤、主图和日志
日志表格与追踪瀑布图
数值、时间轴与文字准确性

cases.label: 项目管理 / 看板与详情
cases.prompt: A refined desktop project-management application screenshot. Compact left workspace navigation, top project title and a filter toolbar with search and team avatars. Main area has three kanban columns labeled Planned, Active, Done, each containing several realistic task cards with concise titles, priority marks, due dates and small assignee avatars. On the right, an open task detail panel contains a description, a four-item checklist, activity history and one primary action button. Light gray canvas, white cards, restrained indigo accents, thin dividers, clear typography, no excessive rounded bubbles, no browser chrome, realistic balanced information density.
checks: 三列看板、过滤区和右侧详情
卡片内容层级与主操作
面板空间与文本可读性
不把绘制控件当真实交互

cases.label: 电商详情 / 图库规格与变体
cases.prompt: A premium but practical desktop e-commerce product detail page screenshot for an unbranded compact wireless desk lamp. Left half: a large warm studio product photograph and a row of four consistent product thumbnails. Right half: concise product title, rating, price, color swatches, quantity control, a clear Add to cart button and delivery details. Below the fold visible in the image: Specifications tabs and a compact technical table, plus a small related-products row. Warm ivory background, charcoal typography, sage accents, excellent spacing, clear hierarchy, realistic dense content without clutter. No fake browser window or device frame. Keep product design consistent across thumbnails.
checks: 主图与缩略图产品一致性
文字与数字不作为真实商品信息

cases.label: 移动财务 / 图表交易与筛选
cases.prompt: A polished mobile personal-finance dashboard screenshot, full-screen interface without a phone frame. At the top a monthly balance overview and a month selector; underneath a compact spending trend line chart and three category totals. The main area shows a readable recent-transactions list with category icons, merchant names, dates and right-aligned amounts. Add compact filter chips above the list, a small budget progress section and a fixed bottom navigation bar with four simple icons. Soft white background, near-black text, restrained forest-green accents, strong numeric hierarchy and carefully aligned dense information, no glass or gradients, no brand logos.
checks: 余额、趋势、分类、流水与底栏
金额对齐和移动阅读密度
视觉稿而非真实财务数据

cases.label: 中文科研平台 / 表格与详情
cases.prompt: 一张精致、信息密度较高但清晰的中文科研实验管理平台桌面页面视觉稿，不要浏览器边框。左侧窄导航栏，中间是实验运行表格，右侧是当前选中实验的详情面板。顶部包含项目名、搜索框、日期筛选和新建实验按钮。表格包含运行编号、模型、数据集、状态、准确率、耗时六列，有八行内容；详情面板包含配置摘要、一张训练损失折线图、三个关键指标和产物列表。暖白背景、深灰文字、克制的蓝绿色强调色，边框细、层级清楚、控件对齐。页面主标题准确写“实验管理”，主要导航准确写“项目、实验、数据、报告”。不要装饰性渐变和无意义巨幅留白。
checks: 中文标题导航能否准确
八行六列表格与右侧实验详情
真实文字和数据必须另实现

cases.label: 写实面部 / 皮肤眼睛发丝
cases.prompt: An extremely detailed but natural editorial head-and-shoulders portrait of an original adult woman in her late twenties, with dark brown wavy hair tucked behind one ear and a simple cream crew-neck shirt. Looking directly at the camera, relaxed closed lips. Face occupies most of the frame. Clearly resolved eyelashes, coherent iris reflections, natural pores, subtle freckles and fine individual hair strands, no waxy airbrushing and no excessive sharpening. Soft large window light from the left, neutral warm-gray studio background, realistic anatomy, honest photographic texture, no jewelry obscuring facial features, no text or logos.
checks: 眼睑、虹膜反光、睫毛与嘴部
毛孔、细发、皮肤不过度磨皮
面部近看而非仅缩略图好看
合成人物，无真人身份要求

cases.label: 男性侧转脸 / 胡须与耳部
cases.prompt: A finely detailed three-quarter studio portrait of an original adult man around forty with short textured dark hair and neatly trimmed stubble, wearing a plain dark blue cotton shirt. Turn his head slightly to the right while keeping both eyes visible. Natural asymmetry, realistic ear structure, subtle forehead lines, individual beard hairs and believable skin texture. Soft side key light and gentle fill, muted slate background, shoulders included, relaxed expression, sharp eyes without excessive skin retouching, no text, logos or dramatic beauty effects.
checks: 三分之四视角的双眼与耳朵
不把清晰锐化误当真实细节

cases.label: 严格侧脸 / 鼻唇下颌
cases.prompt: A close detailed photographic side-profile portrait of an original adult East Asian woman in her thirties with straight dark hair tied into a simple low bun. Exactly a clean left-facing ninety-degree profile, only the near eye visible. Show coherent nose, lips, chin, jaw, ear and neck contours, natural skin microtexture and a few fine flyaway hairs. Plain charcoal high-neck top, soft directional studio light, warm gray background, restrained professional editorial photography, no accessories, no text.

cases.label: 女性全身 / 肩胯膝踝
cases.prompt: A highly detailed full-body studio photograph of an original adult female fitness instructor wearing a fitted muted-teal long-sleeve athletic top, charcoal ankle-length leggings and simple white trainers. Neutral professional sportswear, nonsexual pose. Stand in a relaxed contrapposto with weight on one leg, both arms relaxed away from the torso, both hands fully visible with natural separated fingers. Show the entire head and both feet with margins. Anatomically coherent shoulder, elbow, hip, knee and ankle alignment, realistic fabric tension and body proportions, soft even light, plain warm-gray background, no text or logos.
checks: 头到双脚完整、四肢无额外结构
非性感化的成年人运动服肖像

cases.label: 男性动态 / 弓步与关节
cases.prompt: A realistic detailed full-body sports editorial photograph of an original adult male trainer demonstrating a controlled forward lunge in a minimal studio. Plain sleeveless gray training shirt, navy sports shorts, white socks and dark trainers. Front knee bent over the ankle, rear knee lowered without touching the floor, torso upright, both hands resting lightly on his hips with visible fingers. Show his face and both feet fully, believable muscle definition and tendon transitions, coherent elbows, knees and ankles, soft side lighting on a pale gray background. Nonsexual instructional athletic photography, no text, no logos.
checks: 弓步重心、前膝脚踝与后腿
没有凭空多肢或关节错位

cases.label: 面部与双手 / 托杯细节
cases.prompt: A detailed waist-up editorial portrait of an original adult woman in her early thirties seated at a wooden table, wearing a soft beige knit sweater. She holds a small plain ceramic mug in both hands just below her chin, looking toward the camera with a relaxed expression. Clearly show natural finger joints, fingernails and the contact between fingers and the mug; all fingers belong to the correct hand, no fused skin. Sharp facial features with natural skin texture, finely resolved sweater fibers, soft window light and quiet blurred background. No text or logos, no beauty-filter skin.
checks: 手指数量、关节、指甲与杯子接触
遮挡处不凭猜测判五指正确

cases.label: 动漫近脸 / 眼睛与发丝
cases.prompt: A finely finished original anime portrait of an adult female researcher in her late twenties, head and shoulders, short dark indigo hair with subtle individual strands, thoughtful amber eyes and a simple ivory collared shirt. Refined precise linework, coherent pupils and catchlights, delicate layered cel shading around the nose and lips, clean ear anatomy, restrained color harmony, soft rim light, minimal pale blue-gray background. Mature adult character design, no school uniform, no text, no accessories covering the face, polished illustration rather than plastic 3D rendering.
checks: 眼睛、瞳孔、反光与发丝线条

cases.label: 动漫全身 / 服装手部与动态
cases.prompt: A polished full-body illustration of an original adult female field engineer wearing a fitted navy work jacket over a plain light shirt, olive cargo trousers and practical brown boots. She steps forward slightly while holding a small open notebook in her left hand and a pencil in her right. Show the full head, both hands and both boots with margins. Precise anime linework, detailed but coherent hands, natural limb proportions, layered fabric folds, subtle warm and cool cel shading, small utility belt with plausible simple tools, plain warm-ivory background, no text or logos, no sexualized styling.
checks: 成熟角色与非性感化服装
